presets.title: Canonical Normal Sinus Rhythm
presets.nameJa: 正常洞調律 (Canonical Normal Adult v1)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (NORMAL_AND_SINUS: Baseline (Sinus + Purkinje 4-comp QRS + 2-comp P/T))
presets.auditNotes: Full 12-lead canonical baseline; verified V1 rS, V3-V4 transition, V5/V6 qR, Lead algebra exact.

presets.title: Sinus Bradycardia
presets.nameJa: 洞性徐脈 (Sinus Bradycardia)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (NORMAL_AND_SINUS: RhythmSource (SA Node Rate))
presets.auditNotes: SA node discharge rate reduced to 45 bpm without stretching P/QRS durations.

presets.title: Sinus Tachycardia
presets.nameJa: 洞性頻脈 (Sinus Tachycardia)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (NORMAL_AND_SINUS: RhythmSource (SA Node Rate) + Repolarization Timing)
presets.auditNotes: SA discharge elevated to 118 bpm with physiological QT shortening (310 ms) while QRS duration remains 90 ms.

presets.title: Sinus Arrest / Pause (SND)
presets.nameJa: 洞停止 / 洞休止 (Sinus Arrest)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (NORMAL_AND_SINUS: RhythmSource (SA Impulse Generation Failure))
presets.auditNotes: SA impulse generation ceases during pause window; pause duration (1950 ms) is non-integer multiple of baseline PP (833 ms).

presets.title: Sinoatrial (SA) Exit Block Type II (SND)
presets.nameJa: 洞房ブロック (Type II SA Exit Block)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (NORMAL_AND_SINUS: ConductionEngine (SA_EXIT Intermittent Block))
presets.auditNotes: SA_NODE continues firing on schedule (SINUS_IMPULSE emitted), but SA_EXIT blocks every 3rd attempt -> pause is exact 2x PP.

presets.title: Premature Atrial Contraction (PAC)
presets.nameJa: 上室性期外収縮 (PAC)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ECTOPIC: RhythmSource (AtrialEctopicSource) + SA Clock Reset)
presets.auditNotes: Ectopic atrial impulse fires at 460 ms coupling interval, triggers abnormal P recipe, conducts via AV node, and resets SA node schedule.

presets.title: Premature Ventricular Contraction (PVC)
presets.nameJa: 心室性期外収縮 (PVC)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ECTOPIC: RhythmSource (VentricularEctopicSource) + Concealed AV Penetration)
presets.auditNotes: Ventricular ectopic impulse has zero preceding atrial causal link, activates ECTOPIC_RV_QRS_RECIPE (145 ms), and blocks next sinus beat in AV node (compensatory pause).

presets.title: Complete Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB)
presets.nameJa: 完全右脚ブロック (Complete RBBB)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (BUNDLE_AND_FASCICULAR_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (RIGHT_BUNDLE disabled) + Delayed RV Activation Component)
presets.primaryDomain: ConductionEngine (RIGHT_BUNDLE disabled) + Delayed RV Activation Component
presets.auditNotes: Preserves early septal/LV vectors and appends delayed RV anterior/outflow activation (52-135 ms); projects simultaneously as V1 terminal R' and I/V6 wide S.

presets.title: Complete Left Bundle Branch Block (LBBB)
presets.nameJa: 完全左脚ブロック (Complete LBBB)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (BUNDLE_AND_FASCICULAR_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (LEFT_BUNDLE disabled) + Replaced Septal/LV Sequence)
presets.auditNotes: Replaces normal left-to-right septal vector with RV initiation -> slow transseptal -> delayed LV free-wall components (overlapping double-peak notched R in I/V5/V6, deep QS/rS in V1).

presets.title: Left Anterior Fascicular Block (LAFB)
presets.nameJa: 左脚前枝ブロック (LAFB)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (BUNDLE_AND_FASCICULAR_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (LAF disabled) + 2-Stage Fascicular Activation Recipe)
presets.auditNotes: No axis override used. Left axis deviation (~ -48 deg), qR in I/aVL, and rS in II/III/aVF emerge strictly from early LPF exit (+115 deg) + late unopposed superior-leftward sweep (-55 deg).

presets.title: Left Posterior Fascicular Block (LPFB)
presets.nameJa: 左脚後枝ブロック (LPFB)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (BUNDLE_AND_FASCICULAR_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (LPF disabled) + 2-Stage Fascicular Activation Recipe)
presets.auditNotes: No axis override used. Right axis deviation (~ +112 deg), rS in I/aVL, and qR in II/III/aVF emerge strictly from early LAF exit (-45 deg) + late inferior-rightward sweep (+118 deg).

presets.title: First-Degree AV Block
presets.nameJa: 第1度房室ブロック (1st-Degree AV Block)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (AV_CONDUCTION_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (AV_NODE baseDelayMs prolonged))
presets.auditNotes: Every atrial activation conducts 1:1 with stable prolonged PR interval (260 ms > 200 ms).

presets.title: Second-Degree AV Block Mobitz Type I (Wenckebach)
presets.nameJa: 第2度房室ブロック Wenckebach型 (Mobitz Type I)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (AV_CONDUCTION_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (AV_NODE Decremental Recovery/Fatigue Kinetics))
presets.auditNotes: Zero hardcoded PR arrays. Emerges from exponential diastolic fatigue recovery (tau=1650ms) and incremental fatigue accumulation (0.44) until block threshold (0.92).

presets.title: Second-Degree AV Block Mobitz Type II
presets.nameJa: 第2度房室ブロック Mobitz II型 (Mobitz Type II)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (AV_CONDUCTION_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (HIS Intermittent Block))
presets.auditNotes: Constant PR interval (170 ms) across conducted beats with sudden His-Purkinje conduction failure (CONDUCTION_BLOCKED at HIS).

presets.title: Third-Degree (Complete) AV Block
presets.nameJa: 第3度（完全）房室ブロック (Complete AV Block)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (AV_CONDUCTION_BLOCK: ConductionEngine (AV_NODE disabled) + Dual Independent Rhythm Clocks)
presets.primaryDomain: ConductionEngine (AV_NODE disabled) + Dual Independent Rhythm Clocks
presets.auditNotes: SA node (80 bpm) and VentricularEscapeSource (38 bpm) run on independent clocks; verified zero parentEventId/triggerEventId causal chains from atria to ventricles.

presets.title: Atrial Fibrillation (AF)
presets.nameJa: 心房細動 (Atrial Fibrillation)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (SUPRAVENTRICULAR_AND_PREEXCITATION: RhythmSource (Chaotic Atrial Wavelets) + AV Nodal Refractory Filtering)
presets.primaryDomain: RhythmSource (Chaotic Atrial Wavelets) + AV Nodal Refractory Filtering
presets.auditNotes: No organized P wave recipe used. High-rate atrial wavelets bombard AV_NODE; AV_NODE blocks impulses arriving during refractory period, yielding irregularly irregular ventricular RR intervals.

presets.title: Atrial Flutter (Typical 300 bpm / AV Nodal Filtering)
presets.nameJa: 心房粗動 (Atrial Flutter 3:1/4:1)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (SUPRAVENTRICULAR_AND_PREEXCITATION: RhythmSource (300 bpm FlutterSource) + AV Nodal Refractory Filtering)
presets.primaryDomain: RhythmSource (300 bpm FlutterSource) + AV Nodal Refractory Filtering
presets.auditNotes: Emits discrete 200ms cycle atrial flutter impulses + continuous inferior sawtooth dipole; AV_NODE refractory period (520ms) filters 300 bpm atrial rate to 3:1/4:1 ventricular response.

presets.title: Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) Pattern
presets.nameJa: WPW症候群パターン (Short PR + Delta Wave Fusion)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (SUPRAVENTRICULAR_AND_PREEXCITATION: Dual Conduction Route (ACCESSORY_PATHWAY + AV_NODE/HIS) + Preexcitation Fusion Recipe)
presets.primaryDomain: Dual Conduction Route (ACCESSORY_PATHWAY + AV_NODE/HIS) + Preexcitation Fusion Recipe
presets.auditNotes: Parallel conduction events emitted for ACCESSORY_PATHWAY (arriving at P+95 ms) and AV_NODE->HIS (arriving at P+130 ms); Kent arrival precedes HIS arrival by 35 ms, producing a 95 ms short PR, initial slurred delta wave (0-58 ms), and His-Purkinje fusion (35-125 ms).

presets.title: Junctional Escape Rhythm
presets.nameJa: 房室接合部調律 (Junctional Rhythm)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (SUPRAVENTRICULAR_AND_PREEXCITATION: RhythmSource (JunctionalEscapeSource 50 bpm))
presets.auditNotes: PARTIAL: Antegrade narrow ventricular conduction is implemented, but variable retrograde atrial conduction timing (retrograde P before/during/after QRS) is not yet parameterized.

presets.title: Monomorphic Ventricular Tachycardia (VT)
presets.nameJa: 単形性心室頻拍 (Monomorphic VT)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (VENTRICULAR_ARRHYTHMIA: RhythmSource (VTSource 165 bpm) + Ectopic Ventricular Recipe)
presets.auditNotes: Rapid regular ventricular ectopic sequence (165 bpm) with wide QRS (150 ms) and secondary ST-T discordance.

presets.title: Torsades de Pointes (Polymorphic VT)
presets.nameJa: トルサード・ド・ポワント (Torsades de Pointes)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (VENTRICULAR_ARRHYTHMIA: RhythmSource (Polymorphic VTSource) + Beat-to-Beat 3D Spatial Vector Rotation)
presets.primaryDomain: RhythmSource (Polymorphic VTSource) + Beat-to-Beat 3D Spatial Vector Rotation
presets.auditNotes: Each beat carries progressive phaseAngleRad rotating the 3D CardiacSourceState vector and modulating envelope; all 12 leads co-vary consistently via LeadField.

presets.title: Acute Anteroseptal STEMI Pattern
presets.nameJa: 急性前壁中隔心筋梗塞パターン (Acute Anteroseptal STEMI)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION: STSegmentRecipe (Anterior/Septal Injury Vector) + Hyperacute Repolarization)
presets.auditNotes: Anterior/septal injury current (+Z, septal, rvAnterior) projects via LeadField to produce ST elevation in V1-V4 and hyperacute T wave without per-lead editing.

presets.title: Old Anteroseptal MI Pattern (Pathological Q / Poor R Progression)
presets.nameJa: 陳旧性前壁中隔心筋梗塞パターン (Old Anteroseptal MI)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION: ActivationRecipe (Loss of Anterior Septal Force) + Resolved ST)
presets.primaryDomain: ActivationRecipe (Loss of Anterior Septal Force) + Resolved ST
presets.auditNotes: Loss of initial anterior septal & early apical vectors (A_SEPTAL/B_EARLY z inverted) yields QS/pathological Q in V1-V3 and poor R progression with isoelectric ST.

presets.title: Acute Inferior STEMI Pattern
presets.nameJa: 急性下壁心筋梗塞パターン (Acute Inferior STEMI)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION: STSegmentRecipe (Inferior Injury Vector +105 deg) + Early Inferior Loss)
presets.primaryDomain: STSegmentRecipe (Inferior Injury Vector +105 deg) + Early Inferior Loss
presets.auditNotes: Inferior injury dipole (+105 deg) simultaneously projects as ST elevation in II, III, aVF and reciprocal ST depression in I, aVL via Einthoven lead geometry.

presets.title: Old Inferior MI Pattern
presets.nameJa: 陳旧性下壁心筋梗塞パターン (Old Inferior MI)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION: ActivationRecipe (Loss of Early Inferior Forces) + Resolved ST)
presets.primaryDomain: ActivationRecipe (Loss of Early Inferior Forces) + Resolved ST
presets.auditNotes: Superior initial vector (-80 deg) produces deep pathological Q waves in II, III, aVF with resolved ST segment.

presets.title: Acute High Lateral STEMI Pattern
presets.nameJa: 急性側壁心筋梗塞パターン (Acute Lateral STEMI)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (MYOCARDIAL_INFARCTION: STSegmentRecipe (High-Lateral Injury Vector -20 deg))
presets.auditNotes: PARTIAL: Projects lateral ST elevation (I, aVL, V5, V6) and inferior reciprocal depression (III, aVF), but lacks dedicated lateral Q-wave evolution components.

presets.title: Hyperkalemia ECG Phenotype
presets.nameJa: 高カリウム血症パターン (Hyperkalemia)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ELECTROLYTE_AND_CHANNELOPATHY: Severity-Driven Electrolyte Phenotype (canonicalSeverity = 0.74: T peaking + P attenuation + PR/QRS widening))
presets.primaryDomain: Severity-Driven Electrolyte Phenotype (canonicalSeverity = 0.74: T peaking + P attenuation + PR/QRS widening)
presets.auditNotes: Driven by continuous severity model (canonicalSeverity = 0.74 in [0, 1]; not mapped 1:1 to serum K+): P amp 0.45x, P dur 118ms, PR 215ms, QRS 112ms, T amp 2.85x.

presets.title: Hypokalemia ECG Phenotype (Prominent U Wave)
presets.nameJa: 低カリウム血症パターン (Hypokalemia)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ELECTROLYTE_AND_CHANNELOPATHY: Multi-Parameter Electrolyte Phenotype (T flattening + ST depression + UWaveRecipe))
presets.primaryDomain: Multi-Parameter Electrolyte Phenotype (T flattening + ST depression + UWaveRecipe)
presets.auditNotes: Attenuates T wave (0.38x), adds mild ST depression vector, and activates independent UWaveRecipe (0.18 mV post-T wave).

presets.title: Hypercalcemia ECG Phenotype (Short QT)
presets.nameJa: 高カルシウム血症パターン (Hypercalcemia - Short QT)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ELECTROLYTE_AND_CHANNELOPATHY: Repolarization Timing (Shortened Action Potential Phase 2 / QT 285 ms))
presets.primaryDomain: Repolarization Timing (Shortened Action Potential Phase 2 / QT 285 ms)
presets.auditNotes: Shortens ventricular repolarization duration to yield QT = 285 ms (QTc Fridericia ~ 307 ms) without altering QRS duration.

presets.title: Hypocalcemia ECG Phenotype (Prolonged QT)
presets.nameJa: 低カルシウム血症パターン (Hypocalcemia - Prolonged QT)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ELECTROLYTE_AND_CHANNELOPATHY: Repolarization Timing (Prolonged Action Potential Phase 2 / QT 475 ms))
presets.primaryDomain: Repolarization Timing (Prolonged Action Potential Phase 2 / QT 475 ms)
presets.auditNotes: Lengthens ST-T repolarization episode to yield QT = 475 ms (QTc Fridericia ~ 512 ms) without widening QRS.

presets.title: Acute Pericarditis Pattern
presets.nameJa: 急性心膜炎パターン (Acute Pericarditis)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (PERICARDIAL_AND_CHAMBER_AXIS: STSegmentRecipe (Diffuse Epicardial Injury Vector +50 deg))
presets.auditNotes: PARTIAL: Diffuse epicardial ST vector (+50 deg, anterior) produces widespread ST elevation (I, II, V2-V6) and aVR ST depression, but atrial PR-segment depression is not yet modeled.

presets.title: Brugada ECG Pattern Type 1 (Coved ST Elevation)
presets.nameJa: Brugada心電図パターン Type 1 (Coved型 ST上昇)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ELECTROLYTE_AND_CHANNELOPATHY: STSegmentRecipe (RVOT J-Wave + Negative Slope ST + Anterior T Discordance))
presets.primaryDomain: STSegmentRecipe (RVOT J-Wave + Negative Slope ST + Anterior T Discordance)
presets.auditNotes: Modeled as a Brugada ECG pattern (not clinical diagnosis) via right-anterior/RVOT spatial source (septal + rvAnterior + +Z) projecting across V1-V3 with coved descending ST and negative V1 T wave.

presets.title: Brugada ECG Pattern Type 2 (Saddle-Back ST Elevation)
presets.nameJa: Brugada心電図パターン Type 2 (Saddle-back型 ST上昇)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (ELECTROLYTE_AND_CHANNELOPATHY: STSegmentRecipe (RVOT J-Wave + Rising Saddle-Back ST + Positive V2 T))
presets.primaryDomain: STSegmentRecipe (RVOT J-Wave + Rising Saddle-Back ST + Positive V2 T)
presets.auditNotes: Modeled as a Brugada ECG pattern via RVOT regional source with early J-wave peak followed by elevated positive-slope ST saddle and positive T wave in V2 (V1/V2 dominant, V3 smaller, limb leads minimal).

presets.title: Ventricular Demand Pacemaker (VVI 68 bpm)
presets.nameJa: ペースメーカ調律 (VVI Demand Pacing)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (DEVICE_AND_ANATOMY: DeviceEngine (Intrinsic Ventricular Sensing/Inhibition + Lower-Rate Timeout Stimulus & Capture))
presets.primaryDomain: DeviceEngine (Intrinsic Ventricular Sensing/Inhibition + Lower-Rate Timeout Stimulus & Capture)
presets.auditNotes: Senses intrinsic ventricular activation (VVI_INHIBIT -> resets lower-rate timer) and delivers PACEMAKER_STIMULUS + CAPTURE_SUCCESS + wide RV-apex paced QRS when no intrinsic beat arrives before 68 bpm timeout.

presets.title: Dual-Chamber Sequential Pacemaker (DDD 72 bpm)
presets.nameJa: デュアルチャンバ・ペースメーカ調律 (DDD Sequential Pacing)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (DEVICE_AND_ANATOMY: DeviceEngine (Sequential Atrial + Ventricular Stimulus & Capture))
presets.auditNotes: PARTIAL: Emits paired atrial and ventricular PACEMAKER_STIMULUS + CAPTURE_SUCCESS events separated by programmed 160 ms AV delay under complete AV block, but full P-synchronous tracking (AS-VP) and upper-rate Wenckebach behavior are not yet implemented.

presets.title: Left Axis Deviation (-45° Axis Parameter Preset)
presets.nameJa: 左軸偏位パラメータ (-45° Axis Rotation)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (PERICARDIAL_AND_CHAMBER_AXIS: Spatial Axis Rotation (SET_SPATIAL_AXIS -45 deg))
presets.auditNotes: PARTIAL: Pure frontal axis rotation modifier for educational comparison against fascicular block (use LAFB preset for conduction-driven left axis deviation).

presets.title: Right Axis Deviation (+115° Axis Parameter Preset)
presets.nameJa: 右軸偏位パラメータ (+115° Axis Rotation)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (PERICARDIAL_AND_CHAMBER_AXIS: Spatial Axis Rotation (SET_SPATIAL_AXIS +115 deg))
presets.auditNotes: PARTIAL: Pure frontal axis rotation modifier for educational comparison against fascicular block (use LPFB preset for conduction-driven right axis deviation).

presets.title: Dextrocardia (Mirror-Image Situs Inversus)
presets.nameJa: 右胸心 (Dextrocardia - Anatomical Mirror Transform)
presets.validationProfile: 7-Category Biophysical & Clinical Validator (DEVICE_AND_ANATOMY: AnatomyConfig (Mirror-Image Cardiac Geometry Transform))
presets.auditNotes: Inverts +X to -X and mirrors regional ventricular proximity so Lead I is negative AND precordial R amplitude decreases from V1 to V6 (distinct from RA/LA cable reversal).
